title: Content Writer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

● Research, plan, write, and edit SEO\-focused content for websites, blogs, landing pages, service pages, location pages, PRs, and other digital assets.

● Produce content aligned with the search intent, audience expectations, and business objectives of each page.

● Write naturally for North American and UK audiences with appropriate vocabulary, tone, sentence structure, and market\-specific communication styles.

● Conduct topic, competitor, SERP, keyword, and entity research before developing content.

● Structure content to improve readability, crawlability, topical relevance, and search engine understanding.

● Create content that supports both traditional organic search and AI\-powered search platforms.

● Apply E\-E\-A\-T principles while developing informative, reliable, and authoritative content.

● Identify relevant entities, subtopics, supporting themes, and contextual relationships required to build topical depth.

● Incorporate primary, secondary, semantic, and supporting keywords naturally without compromising readability.

● Develop content around keyword intent rather than keyword frequency alone.

● Apply internal linking opportunities and support broader topical authority strategies.

● Use appropriate copywriting frameworks for commercial and conversion\-focused pages.

● Adapt writing style, structure, and tone according to the content format, industry, target audience, and stage of the customer journey.

● Review and improve existing content for SEO performance, clarity, accuracy, engagement, and conversion potential.

● Fact\-check statistics, claims, technical information, and other factual references before submission.

● Collaborate with SEO strategists, designers, developers, and account teams to ensure content aligns with the overall digital strategy.

**What We’re Looking For:**

✔ Keyword Research \& Search Intent  
✔ Semantic SEO \& Topical Authority  
✔ Content Architecture \& Internal Linking  
✔ E\-E\-A\-T \& On\-Page SEO  
✔ SERP \& Competitor Analysis  
✔ AIDA, PAS \& FAB Copywriting Frameworks  
✔ AEO, GEO \& AI Citations

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Content strategy: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person
